title: NFL Week 8 Prop Points: 17 Player Props & Best Bets
transcript_summary: John Hansen ('The Guru') delivers 17 analytical NFL Week 8 player props based on coverage rates (Cover 1/3/4), blitz target shares, and defensive matchups, naming Michael Wilson over 55.5 receiving yards his Best Bet.

speaker_segments.speaker: John Hansen
speaker_segments.text: Leans: Zay Flowers o81.5 rec yds, Amon-Ra St. Brown over rec yds, Derrick Henry o77.5 rush yds, Ja'Marr Chase o79.5 rec yds.

speaker_segments.speaker: John Hansen
speaker_segments.text: Unders: Tony Pollard u65.5 rush yds, Sam LaPorta u4.5 rec, Carnell Tate u4.5 rec.

speaker_segments.speaker: John Hansen
speaker_segments.text: Top Props: DJ Moore o55.5 rec yds, Chase Brown o54.5 rush yds, Ryan Flournoy o33.5 rec yds, Jahmyr Gibbs over rush yds, Kenneth Walker III o85.5 rush yds, DK Metcalf o53.5 rec yds, Michael Mayer o25.5 rec yds, T.J. Hockenson o39.5 rec yds, Noah Gray o13.5 rec yds, and Michael Wilson o55.5 rec yds (Best Bet).

extracted_picks.rationale: Highest total on board (54.5); Moore leads NFL in air yards per route and excels vs Cover 3/4.

extracted_picks.speaker: John Hansen
extracted_picks.rationale: Bengals 10.5 favorites; Titans allow 7th most rush yards and 5th highest rush success rate.

extracted_picks.rationale: Cardinals funnel targets to the slot (9th most fantasy points allowed) where Flournoy operates.

extracted_picks.speaker: John Hansen
extracted_picks.rationale: Detroit's answer to Viking blitz is running Gibbs; Vikings allow 12th most adjusted yards before contact.

extracted_picks.rationale: Walker shredded Denver in opener (23-173); highly game script sensitive and KC projected to lead.

extracted_picks.rationale: Browns run single-high looks at highest rate in NFL; Metcalf sees 35% boost to YPRR vs single-high.

extracted_picks.rationale: Lions allow most receiving yards and receptions to tight ends; extreme pass funnel defense.

extracted_picks.rationale: Broncos allow 8th most receiving yards to tight ends; model projects 115% beat on 13.5 line.

extracted_picks.rationale: BEST BET: Cowboys run Cover 3; Wilson averages 2.03 YPRR with 34% target share vs Cover 3 in high-total shootout.
